item.property_name: Distributive Property of Multiplication over Addition
item.statement: a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
item.explanation: Multiplying a sum by a factor is equal to multiplying each addend separately by the factor and adding the products.

item.procedure_name: Locating Matrix Cell Entry in Endless 4-Column Grid
steps: Divide given number N by 4: N = 4 * q + r.
If remainder r > 0: Column c = r, Row r_num = q + 1.
If remainder r = 0: Column c = 4, Row r_num = q.

item.procedure_name: Paper Folding Parallel and Perpendicular Construction
steps: Fold a sheet of square paper in half horizontally to make crease L1.
Fold in half horizontally again to make creases L2 and L3 parallel to L1.
Unfold and fold the sheet vertically in half across all horizontal creases.
Observe that vertical crease P forms right angles (90°) with all horizontal parallel creases.

If smaller sum <= longest side: arcs will not intersect and triangle cannot exist.
